title: Outlet Shoppes at Laredo to Hold Ninth Annual Tree Lighting Tonight
excerpt: The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo will hold its ninth annual tree lighting Friday at 6 p.m. at 1600 Water St., with local vendors, musical performances and surprise guests.
content:
The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo will hold its ninth annual tree lighting on Friday, Nov. 20, at 6 p.m. The event takes place at the Outlet Shoppes at Laredo, 1600 Water St.

The celebration will feature local vendors, musical performances and surprise guests, and organizers invite families and friends to attend.

People who cannot attend in person can watch the tree lighting on the evening news broadcast on Nov. 20. No admission price was stated for the event.
